messages.author: c98af2c83883e808
messages.subject: managing plot appearance using layer()
parts:
Hi All,
I am a regular R user, but new to ggplot. I am building some simple
scatter plots using the layer() function. I wish to display a subset
of my data using unfilled circles, instead of the default, but I have
yet to find in my searches any clear instructions on how to manipulate
the type of points I wish to display in layer(), if I do not want to
have a "scale" determined by a particular vector in my data frame...

#example script

plot1 = ggplot()+
layer(data=tdata, mapping = aes(y = Chao2, x = dem250), geom =
"point", colour = "black")+
layer(data=AWTNdata, mapping = aes(y = Chao2, x = dem250), geom =
"point")+
layer(data=AWTSdata, mapping = aes(y = Chao2, x = dem250), geom =
"point")+
layer(data=CYPdata, mapping = aes(y = Chao2, x = dem250), geom =
"point", colour = "blue")+
layer(data=CEQdata, mapping = aes(y = Chao2, x = dem250), geom =
"point", colour = "red")
... etc

The last two series are those that I want to display unfilled... Any
thoughts would be much appreciated!
Cheers
A
